known_issues: PDF generation from the Export screen still fails with the same errors for all 3 products (regression/ongoing issue after v24 deployment).

existing_features.title: Make PDF and ZIP generation robust by removing reliance on CDN-provided global variables and ensuring jsPDF and JSZip are available in production builds.

Improve error reporting during generation so the UI shows the actual root-cause message (in English) for failures, including whether the failure occurred during cover fetch, PDF generation, or ZIP generation, and for which product.
